notes.title: Battle Sweeper is going free on 04/04/25!
notes.content:
Battle Sweeper will soon be free to keep forever. Enjoy the game and keep battling!

The game will go free on 04/04/25 at 07:00 PST.

notes.title: Battle Sweeper Summer Discount!
notes.content:
Greetings to all of you sweepers and potential sweepers out there!

Battle Sweeper will be on discount for the duration of the Steam Summer Sale. This is a great time to pick up the game and see how deep you can delve into the dungeon.

More than just Minesweeper, Battle Sweeper allows you to fight and continue on instead of failing at the first mistake. The monsters are hiding in wait to eat you, so let's make sure they don't get their fill.

Enjoy the game and thanks to everyone for their support!

notes.title: Battle Sweeper Winter Sale
notes.content:

notes.title: Battle Sweeper Version 1.1 Released!
notes.content:
[h2]Thanks[/h2]

I would first like to thank everyone for their patience, support, help, and suggestions for making Battle Sweeper what it is today. With the feedback I received, I was able to squash bugs and make a large number of improvements to the game.

[h2]Version 1.1 Released[/h2]

This version includes all of the previous bug fixes along with some new additions:

[list]
[*] There is now a subtle background for the main game
[*] A new set of tiles has been added for more variety
[*] Poison has been added to the battle system - at every 5th level, the player will receive a flask of poison which can be used to insta-kill any enemy
[*] A few smaller bugs have been fixed
[/list]

All of the previous fixes can be found in a post on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1380360/discussions/]Battle Sweeper Forums[/url]

[h2]Game Dev Info[/h2]

Also on the forums, I've added two posts describing my experience developing Battle Sweeper as a solo developer and tips for anyone interested in game development. Feel free to comment or leave feedback.

Enjoy the new update and make sure to report any bugs.

notes.title: Battle Sweeper is now available with a launch discount!
notes.content:
[h1]Release![/h1]

The dungeons are open and ready to conquer.

Battle Sweeper is now available for purchase on Steam. Get it between August 13th and 20th with a 10% launch discount!

For those who love Minesweeper, get ready for something very different. Now instead of just killing time, you can kill monsters too. Making that one mistake will no longer end your awesome run - fight those monsters and keep going.

[h1]The Road Ahead[/h1]

Please feel free to leave your feedback, questions, or anything else you would like to know on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1380360/discussions/]discussion forums[/url] and we will do our best to respond in a timely manner.

We hope you enjoy the game and look forward to making improvements to the game and squashing any bugs that crop up.
